info.name: IMS - Demands screen
info.description:
# Demands screen API

A demand is a request for items for a storage location. The DG PDMA refers each line and approves, rejects or rationalizes it from warehouse stock; lines requested from NDMA are decided by NDMA only; return requests sent to a district are decided by that district. Warehouses only issue.

**Demand status:** pending → in_process → approved → partly_issued → completed (or rejected).
**Line status:** pending / approved / rejected; `rationalized` when approved for less.

## Roles
| Variable | Role | Account |
|---|---|---|
| `token_dg` | DG PDMA (master) | approves warehouse movements and returns, refers and decides demands |
| `token_warehouse` | Storage location user at a **Warehouse** | records movements (wait for DG approval), issues demands |
| `token_district` | Storage location user at a **District** | uses its own stock, returns stock, decides return requests |
| `token_ndma` | NDMA | only NDMA-owned stock and demand lines referred to NDMA |
| `token_inspection` | Inspection team | approves status changes |

## Variables
`item`, `sub_cat`, `spec` = Boat / Fiberglass / 19 ft; `warehouse` = Lahore Warehouse (1) gives; `district` = Lahore district (2) demands. Change them to match the test data.

item.name: 00 Log in
item.description: One login per role used below.

request.description:
Log in and keep the access token for the **dg** requests. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access>` on every other call; refresh it with `POST /api/auth/refresh/ {"refresh": "..."}` when it expires.

The `user` object says what the screens should show: `role`, `storage_location_id` / `storage_location_name` (none for DG PDMA, NDMA and the inspection team) and `can_approve_demands`.

Log in and keep the access token for the **warehouse** requests. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access>` on every other call; refresh it with `POST /api/auth/refresh/ {"refresh": "..."}` when it expires.

The `user` object says what the screens should show: `role`, `storage_location_id` / `storage_location_name` (none for DG PDMA, NDMA and the inspection team) and `can_approve_demands`.

Log in and keep the access token for the **district** requests. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access>` on every other call; refresh it with `POST /api/auth/refresh/ {"refresh": "..."}` when it expires.

The `user` object says what the screens should show: `role`, `storage_location_id` / `storage_location_name` (none for DG PDMA, NDMA and the inspection team) and `can_approve_demands`.

Log in and keep the access token for the **ndma** requests. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access>` on every other call; refresh it with `POST /api/auth/refresh/ {"refresh": "..."}` when it expires.

The `user` object says what the screens should show: `role`, `storage_location_id` / `storage_location_name` (none for DG PDMA, NDMA and the inspection team) and `can_approve_demands`.

Log in and keep the access token for the **inspection** requests. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access>` on every other call; refresh it with `POST /api/auth/refresh/ {"refresh": "..."}` when it expires.

The `user` object says what the screens should show: `role`, `storage_location_id` / `storage_location_name` (none for DG PDMA, NDMA and the inspection team) and `can_approve_demands`.
`can_approve_demands` is true for the DG PDMA and NDMA: show the decision inbox. Storage location users raise demands, issue (warehouses) and decide return requests (districts).

item.name: 01 Setup (test data only)
item.description: Puts NDMA stock in the warehouse so the NDMA steps have something to give. Not part of the screen.

item.name: 02 Raise a demand (district / warehouse user)
item.description:
Any user raises a demand for their own storage location (left out = their own); the DG PDMA chooses one.
Item lines use the same item → sub category → spec dropdowns as transactions (`/api/items/<id>/options/`).
A demand can be edited or deleted while every line is still pending.

request.description: Response: `demand_no` (DMD-YYYY-NNNNN), `status` (pending), and `lines[]` with `line_id`, `status`, `referred_to`, `referred_owner`, `available_quantity`, `approved_quantity`, `issued_quantity`, `rationalized`, `allocations[]`, `can_decide`.
Filters: `status` (pending, in_process, approved, partly_issued, completed, rejected), `for_storage_location`, `referred_to`, `awaiting_my_decision=true`.
Send `lines` to replace all lines.
Validation shown per line.

item.name: 03 DG PDMA reviews and refers
item.description:
The DG sees every pending line (`awaiting_my_decision=true`), the quantity available on each line, and
refers it: to a warehouse (PDMA stock), to NDMA (`"owner": 2`, a request to NDMA) or to a district (a return request).

request.description: Lines the DG can decide now. `available_quantity` = stock that can still be given (not promised to other demands) by the warehouses (or NDMA / the district the line is referred to).
Rows: `storage_location_id`, `storage_location_name`, `is_district`, `owner_id`, `owner_name`, `on_hand`, `reserved`, `available`. Use it to choose where to approve from.
Also `POST /api/demands/<id>/refer/ {"referred_to": id, "owner": 1|2, "lines": [ids]}` for several lines.
Only NDMA decides it now; it leaves the DG inbox.

item.name: 04 Decide (DG PDMA / NDMA)
item.description:
Approve with allocations `[{"from_storage_location": id, "quantity": n}]` (several = split over storage locations);
approving less than demanded is **rationalizing** (`rationalized: true`). Approved quantities are reserved until issued.

item.name: DG cannot decide an NDMA line

request.description: Only lines referred to NDMA.
`owner` 2 is implied for NDMA lines.
Warehouses only issue.

item.name: 05 Issue (giving warehouse)
item.description:
The giving storage location issues approved quantities, at once or in parts. Each issue is a transaction
(Dispatch to a district / Internal Transfer between warehouses / Return to a warehouse, chosen automatically) linked to the demand and approved at once.
`allocation` is needed when a line is split over several storage locations; `quantity` defaults to what is left.

request.description: Response: `transaction` (with `demand_no`) and the updated `line` (`issued_quantity`).

item.name: Issue the NDMA line (becomes PDMA stock at the district)

request.description: `from_owner_name` NDMA → `owner_name` PDMA.

item.name: 06 Return request (DG → district)
item.description:
Stock at a district is the district's. The DG asks for it back with a demand for a warehouse, referred to the
district; **the district** accepts, rejects or rationalizes it and issues the Return.

item.name: DG raises a return request for the warehouse

request.description: Return requests asked from this district.

`summary` (awaiting_my_decision, approval_rate, fulfilment_rate, overdue_demands...), `by_status`, `by_demanding_location`, `by_giving_location`, `by_item`, `by_month`, `recent`. Filters: `date_from`, `date_to`, `storage_location`, `location`, `referred_to`, `category`, `item`.
